about.label: Resources
about.text: What a world holds that a ship could take: kinds counted off its composition, kept on the books (mined out, stocked), and a label while enough is left.

kinds.name: Iron and nickel
kinds.about: at least 40% iron by mass, as Mercury (Earth is about 32%): an iron world or the core of a broken one

kinds.name: Water
kinds.about: at least 10^18 kg of water at the surface, a small sea's worth or a thick ice cap

kinds.name: Hydrogen
kinds.about: a hydrogen envelope to skim for fuel (at least 10^20 kg)

kinds.name: Helium-3
kinds.about: helium-3 in a giant's envelope, at the birth cloud's isotope share (at least a million tonnes)

tags.about: Tags this pack names (tags design, TG1): labels only, never an input to physics.
